headline: Pakistan's short-term inflation (SPI) stood at 11.32 per cent year-on-year in the week ending October 29, while the index fell 0.35 per cent week-on-week, according to PBS data reported by Dawn.

card.desc: SPI fell 0.35% week-on-week; LPG up 106.86% year-on-year.

caption:
Short-term inflation (SPI) stood at 11.32% year-on-year in the week ending October 29, down from 11.85% the previous week, Dawn reports citing PBS data. The index fell 0.35% week-on-week, but tomatoes rose 34.91%, while chicken and eggs got cheaper.
